long_description:
🎀 PRINCESA PILATES: PICNIC & BIBLE STUDY 🎀

Join us for a beautiful Sunday evening centered around movement, faith, fellowship and feminine wellness. 💕🌸

We’ll begin with a 30-minute Pilates class designed to get your body moving and feeling strong. After Pilates, we’ll slow down for a meaningful Bible study and time to connect with one another. We’ll end the evening with a relaxing yoga and stretch session to leave you feeling refreshed and grounded.

Enjoy a beautiful picnic-style setup with food provided, followed by our sweet ice cream bar! 🍓🍦

✨ EVENT DETAILS ✨ 

📅 Sunday, October 25th 

⏰ 5:00 PM–7:00 PM 

📍 Hermann Park, Houston 

🎟️ Tickets: $25 

🎀 Dress Code: All Pink + Bows💕

WHAT TO EXPECT: 

• 30-minute Pilates class 

• Bible study session 📖 

• Closing yoga & stretch 🧘🏽‍♀️ 

• Picnic-style food provided 🧺 

• Ice cream bar 🍦 

• Community, fellowship & connection 

• A beautiful pink-and-bows atmosphere 🎀

Come dressed in your favorite pink look, bring your Bible and get ready for an evening of movement, faith and community with Princesa Pilates. 👑💕 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Houston, Trips & Adventurous Activities in Houston, Workshops in Houston.
